'''Daler''' is a NPC male student who is seeking advice from another [[Startorch_Academy#Rabelle_College|Syncronist]], '''Phayari''', at night next to the [[Tactical Hologram: Synchronization]].

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Daler:''' Please, I'm begging you! Tell me how you got better!
:'''Daler:''' I'll do whatever it takes to raise my sync rate!

==Dialogue==
:'''Daler:''' Please, I'm begging you! Tell me how you got better! I'll do whatever it takes to raise my sync rate!
:'''Phayari:''' Alright, calm down. The professor confiscated a bunch recently, and the [[Spacetrek Archive]] pulled them too... but I just happen to have a copy.
:'''Daler:''' ...Wait, is it some top-secret training plan? Classified doc? Am I gonna get expelled?!
:'''Phayari:''' Take a closer look. From here on out, we're partners in crime.
:'''Daler:''' Ahhh, I'm not looking! I'm not—Wait, what's this? "One Punch Rover" ...?
:'''Phayari:''' Yep. The school pulled the series when the license expired. No idea when they'll renew it.
:'''Daler:''' "...Complete 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10-kilometer run every day..."
:'''Phayari:''' Shh! Keep it down! If this leaks, we might actually get a cease-and-desist!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* This references the web comic/manga/anime; '''One Punch Man'''.
* School and Academies are required to obtain licenses for copyrighted materials to be used for fair use.
